units.source_text: 一品公主的病痊愈了。

en.t: The First-Rank Princess recovered from her illness.

units.source_text: 僧都也告辞归山。

en.t: The bishop also took his leave and returned to the mountain.

units.source_text: 途中到小野草庵一转，妹尼僧大大地埋怨他：

en.t: On the way, he stopped by the thatched hermitage at Ono, where his nun sister bitterly reproached him:

units.source_text: “这样一个妙龄美女，你给她出了家反而会使她获得罪障呢！

en.t: "For you to make such a beautiful young woman take the vows will only burden her with sin!

units.source_text: 你商量也不同我商量一下，擅自行事，实在太不讲理了！”

en.t: You did not even consult me, but acted on your own. It is utterly unreasonable!"

units.source_text: 但这都是徒然的了。

en.t: But all of this was now in vain.

units.source_text: 僧都说道：“事已如此，现在只管念佛修行吧。

en.t: The bishop said, "Since things have come to this, she should now devote herself simply to chanting the Buddha's name and practicing the Way.

units.source_text: 世人不论老少，夭寿都无一定。

en.t: For people in this world, young or old, there is no fixed measure of a short life or a long one.

units.source_text: 她痛感人生无常，也是确有道理的。”

en.t: It is only reasonable that she should keenly feel the impermanence of life."

units.source_text: 浮舟听了这话，回思往事，颇觉可耻。

en.t: Hearing these words, Ukifune looked back on the past and felt deeply ashamed.

units.source_text: 僧都说：“替她新制法服吧。”

en.t: The bishop said, "Make new religious robes for her."

units.source_text: 便拿出些绫、罗、绢来送给她。

en.t: He then brought out some damask, gauze, and silk, and gave them to her.

units.source_text: 又对她说：“我在存命期间，一定随时照顾你，你不须担忧。

en.t: He also said to her, "As long as I live, I will always look after you, so you need not worry.

units.source_text: 凡是生在这无常的世间而醉心于荣华富贵的人，无论是谁，都觉得这人世恋恋难舍。

en.t: Anyone born into this impermanent world who is intoxicated by glory, wealth, and rank will find it hard to part from this life.

units.source_text: 但你在这山林之中念佛修行，有何可恨，有何可耻呢？

en.t: But if you chant the Buddha's name and practice here among these mountains and forests, what is there to resent, and what is there to be ashamed of?

units.source_text: 人生原是‘命如叶薄’的啊！”

en.t: Human life is, after all, as fragile as a thin leaf!"

units.source_text: 说罢又咏下面的诗句：“松门到晓月徘徊……”

en.t: After saying this, he recited the following poem: "At the pine gate, until dawn, the moon lingers..."

units.source_text: 他虽是法师之身，却也富有优雅之趣。

en.t: Though he was a priest, he still possessed a deeply graceful sensibility.

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“这真是我所愿闻的话了。”

en.t: Ukifune thought, "These are truly the words I had hoped to hear."

units.source_text: 今天尽日刮风，声甚凄咽。

en.t: All day today the wind blew, its sound mournful and sobbing.

units.source_text: 僧都说道：“这种风声‘萧瑟’的日子，伏处山林的人每易堕泪。”

en.t: The bishop said, "On days when the wind sounds so desolate, those who dwell hidden in the mountains are especially prone to tears."

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“我也是伏处山林的人，流泪不止正是理之当然。”

en.t: Ukifune thought, "I too am one who dwells hidden in the mountains, so it is only natural that my tears will not stop."

units.source_text: 便走近窗前，向外眺望，遥见山谷之间有许多穿各种旅装的人，向这边走来。

en.t: She went over to the window and looked out, and in the distance saw many people in various traveling clothes coming this way through the valley.

units.source_text: 欲上比叡山而经过这条路的人，甚是稀有。

en.t: It was very rare for anyone bound for Mount Hiei to pass along this road.

units.source_text: 只有从名叫黑谷的山寺方面步行而来的僧人，有时偶然看到。

en.t: Only monks walking from the mountain temple called Kurodani were sometimes seen by chance.

units.source_text: 今天看到这些穿旅装的俗人，浮舟觉得很奇怪。

en.t: Seeing these laypeople in traveling clothes today, Ukifune found it very strange.

units.source_text: 原来这是为了她而愁恨的中将。

en.t: It turned out to be the Captain, grieving and resentful on her account.

units.source_text: 他是想为这不可挽回之事发些牢骚而来此的。

en.t: He had come here hoping to complain a little about this irreparable matter.

units.source_text: 看见这里的红叶非常美丽，比别处的红叶色彩更鲜，一进门来便觉意趣盎然，设想在这里倘能找到性情爽朗的女子，何等可喜！

en.t: Seeing that the autumn leaves here were extraordinarily beautiful, brighter in color than those elsewhere, he felt the place full of charm as soon as he entered the gate, and thought how delightful it would be if he could find a cheerful woman here.

units.source_text: 便对妹尼僧说：“我因寂寞无聊，想来看看这里的红叶长得如何。

en.t: He then said to the nun sister, "I was lonely and bored, so I came to see how the autumn leaves here had grown.

units.source_text: 总觉难忘旧情，想在这里托庇一宿。”

en.t: I still cannot forget our old ties, and would like to shelter here for one night."

units.source_text: 便坐着欣赏红叶。

en.t: Then he sat and admired the autumn leaves.

units.source_text: 妹尼僧照例容易流泪，泣着赠诗云：

en.t: The nun sister, tearful as usual, wept as she offered him a poem:
